questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a personal project. This experience taught me that ______.
options: I should have started working on it earlier
I would have benefited from more guidance
it is essential to combine theoretical knowledge with practical skills
by then, I was already preparing for a career in industry
questions.answer: it is essential to combine theoretical knowledge with practical skills

questions.question: The new policy will be implemented only if ______.
options: the government decides that it is feasible
there are sufficient funds allocated for its implementation
the company's employees agree to work extra hours without pay
a majority of the stakeholders approve it
questions.answer: a majority of the stakeholders approve it

questions.question: What I find most challenging about learning a new language is ______.
options: the difficulty in remembering vocabulary and grammar rules
the need to constantly practice speaking and listening skills
the fact that native speakers often use idiomatic expressions
the lack of opportunities to engage in authentic conversations
questions.answer: the fact that native speakers often use idiomatic expressions

questions.question: The company's decision to relocate its headquarters was motivated by the need to ______.
options: increase its market share and competitiveness
reduce operational costs and improve efficiency
expand into new markets and diversify its products
improve working conditions for its employees
questions.answer: reduce operational costs and improve efficiency

questions.question: It is essential that the company's management team ______.
options: should be more transparent in their decision-making process
has a better understanding of the market trends and consumer needs
is able to adapt quickly to changes in the industry
communicate effectively with all stakeholders, including employees and investors
questions.answer: communicate effectively with all stakeholders, including employees and investors
